decisive_items: nodular proliferations of thick collagen fibers in large fascicles
firm, red-brown plaques without overlying scale
homogeneous, brightly eosinophilic collagen bundles in haphazard array
response.rationale: C1 is the most complete: it preserves the scleromyxedema diagnosis supported by pruritic firm plaques and haphazard eosinophilic collagen, and adds the histologic subtype directly evidenced by nodular thick collagen fascicles. R3 is the same diagnosis without the subtype; R1 lacks renal/gadolinium exposure and is undermined by absent skin tightening; R2 is directly contradicted by no appreciable skin tightening.

rejected.why: No renal failure or gadolinium exposure; absent skin tightening argues against NSF; systemic sclerosis history is nonspecific.
Directly contradicted by 'There was no appreciable skin tightening in the affected areas'.
